notes.title: Mining Update
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554270/The_Cold_White/


[h3]Hello Cold Survivors![/h3]

There are new ores that you can mine in the cold Alaskan lands where The Cold White takes place.

[h3]Stone[/h3]
Stone can be found everywhere and is used especially in building structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520336/1f525da28a413129cd1b3d3c71c42e9a7c44eaa4.png[/img]


[h3]Coal[/h3]
Coal is important as a fuel. Especially in the production of Iron Bar by melting Iron Ore, coal is needed as fuel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520336/46bdcc7ba3b07f4e3a08484b46ceffc06a2d4a21.png[/img]


[h3]Iron Ore[/h3]
For all tools made from iron, Iron Ore must be melted and converted into Iron Bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520336/75cfa6869651fad98327a27d20887ace0dc85062.png[/img]


See you in the next update!

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
A major update is being prepared for The [b]Cold White[/b]. The following issues have been urgently fixed before the major update:

* [b]Storage[/b] / [b]Chest[/b] can now be built anywhere. You can store your items in chests.

* You can [b]camp[/b] wherever you want when you are away from the center. This way, you can set the camp area as your respawn location.

* Damage rates in [b]Hunger[/b] / [b]Thirst[/b] have been adjusted.

* Language translations have been corrected.

notes.title: Let's play 2Medya Game Studio's anticipated game Pirates Journey Demo !
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520336/ac712c21e03149f6bb108144b5fe7147dac71eb3.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]Broadcasting of Pirates Journey Demo as the developer plays the demo for the Steam Next Fest![/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/]Pirates Journey Steam Page[/url]

Ahoy Pirates! Are you ready to immerse yourself in surviving with your crew on a tropical island? Get ready to live the life of a real pirate in our exciting survival game!

In Pirates Journey:

[b]Set Up Your Camp and Expand:[/b] Gather resources on islands and seas. Build new Buildings. Grow your pirate camp by building buildings like Carpenter, Blacksmith etc.

[b]Survive with your crew:[/b] As the captain, you must survive first. Build new fields for your crews. Organize and train your crews. Give them tasks.

[b]Raid enemy factions and capture their bases:[/b] You are not alone on the islands. Raid the bases of enemy pirate captains. In addition to you, 3 different pirate captains fight among themselves for a total of more than 50 different bases and outposts.

[b]Solve the mysteries of the island and the surrounding seas:[/b] You will learn the stories of 7 pirate captains mentioned in the legends. Dig graves, follow the maps and explore the surroundings to find the treasure they hide.

With its stunning graphics and addictive gameplay, Pirates Journey comes for those who love pirate and survival games.


[b]Pirates Journey demo will be available during the Steam Next Fest from October 9th to October 16th[/b]

We'd love to hear what you think about Pirates Journey demo, as we continue to tirelessly work on Pirates Journey

Make sure to wishlist to get the news on the game and be the first to hear when we announce the release date and other exciting events!

notes.title: The Cold White Pre-release June Update
notes.notes:
Greetings to everyone from the cold world of The Cold White

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520336/a2b0585a31ddb62e80da402dddcc3a138a274270.jpg[/img]

We offer you many innovations in the June update.

* Updated FPS gameplay.
* Added dynamic weather conditions. Snow, storm and many weather conditions.
* Added dynamic cold. Now you will be cold in cold weather. When you enter the house and light a stove, you will be warm.
* All the sounds of The Cold White have been reworked.
* New tools are being prepared to be used for survival.
* Brand new locations have been added to the game map.

See you in the next update.


[previewyoutube=cH4Tissja3A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hello from The Cold White
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520336/1c7dd19eae18f9628ff3a9170cc3d43925a42446.jpg[/img]

Hello from the snow-covered world of The Cold White.

You will feel the cold and maybe make friends with the cold.
On the one hand, you will try to survive and on the other hand, you will run after Alice.

If you find a warm shelter, don't miss it.

Protect yourself from the cold until the next update.
